summary: Tested new billing waitlist feature + minimal admin role (iteration 15). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed covering notify-billing persistence/idempotency, membership.notified_billing field, admin gating (401/403/200), and ADMIN_EMAILS auto-promotion on signup/login. Frontend: Premium notify button, Profile ADMIN section gating, and deep-link admin gate all work correctly. Found one real bug: 'Export CSV' on the admin billing-waitlist screen throws an unhandled native-API error on web instead of the intended clipboard-copy fallback.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Export CSV' on web shows error toast: "The method or property expo-file-system.writeAsStringAsync is not available on web, are you sure you've linked all the native dependencies properly?" instead of the documented/expected web fallback (clipboard-copy of CSV text). Root cause: FileSystem.writeAsStringAsync() itself throws on web BEFORE the code reaches the `Sharing.isAvailableAsync()` check, so the existing clipboard-fallback branch (written for the 'sharing unavailable' case) is never reached — the exception happens one step earlier at the file-write stage, not the share stage. Fix suggestion: detect `Platform.OS === 'web'` and go straight to `Clipboard.setStringAsync(toCsv(items))` on web, skipping FileSystem/Sharing entirely.

action_items: Fix Export CSV web fallback in /app/frontend/app/admin/billing-waitlist.tsx: skip expo-file-system/expo-sharing on Platform.OS === 'web' and copy CSV text to clipboard directly instead.

No other blockers found; all other requested flows (notify-billing persistence/idempotency, notified_billing field, admin gating 401/403/200, ADMIN_EMAILS auto-promotion, Profile ADMIN section visibility, deep-link admin gate, Copy list) verified working.

rca_of_issue: Export CSV bug: exportCsv() in billing-waitlist.tsx calls FileSystem.writeAsStringAsync() unconditionally before checking Sharing.isAvailableAsync(). On the web platform, expo-file-system/legacy's writeAsStringAsync throws immediately (native-only API), so execution never reaches the existing 'else' branch that already contains the correct clipboard-copy fallback logic for CSV text — the catch block instead surfaces the raw thrown error message to the user via toast. Mitigation: branch on Platform.OS === 'web' at the top of exportCsv() and call Clipboard.setStringAsync(toCsv(items)) directly, bypassing FileSystem/Sharing on web.
